feedback_text: Promised 10 minutes, arrived after 47. The ETA on the app kept resetting every few minutes.
Delivered in 9 minutes, still piping hot. Genuinely impressed with the speed.
ETA said 12 minutes but it took almost 40. I would have ordered elsewhere if I knew.
Arrived a couple of minutes early and the tracking map was accurate.
Rider was stuck near my building for 15 minutes and the ETA kept jumping around.
Delivery took 20 minutes. Not the 10 minute promise but acceptable.
Late again. Third time this week the order showed up well past the estimated time.
Fastest delivery I have ever had. The rider was at my door before I finished my call.
The noodles were cold and clumped together by the time they reached me.
Fries were crisp and the burger was hot. Tastes like it was made seconds ago.
Pizza was soggy and lukewarm. Clearly sat around before pickup.
Biryani was fresh and flavourful, portion size was good too.
The chicken tasted stale and the rice was undercooked. Threw most of it away.
Food was okay. Warm but not hot, taste was average.
The coffee arrived barely warm and watery.
Dessert was fresh and perfectly chilled. Loved it.
They forgot my side of fries and gave me the wrong sauce.
Ordered two burgers, received one. Missing item and no apology in the app.
Got someone else's order entirely. Wrong food, wrong name on the bag.
Everything was correct and nothing missing. Appreciate the accuracy.
My vegetarian order came with chicken in it. This is a serious mistake.
Drink was missing again. This keeps happening with this restaurant.
One item was missing but the rest was fine, support added a coupon.
Order was complete and exactly as requested, even the extra napkins.
Delivery fee, surge fee and platform fee on top of a small order. Hidden charges are ridiculous.
The price on the menu changed at checkout. Total was much higher than expected.
Great offers this week, the combo deal saved me a good amount.
Prices are a bit high for the quantity, but the speed makes up for it.
Coupon code failed at payment and I was charged the full amount.
Small order fee on a snack is too much. Very expensive for a quick delivery.
Rider was polite and even waited while I found my door.
Rain surcharge was shown only at the last step. Not transparent.
My favourite restaurant kept showing as available, then cancelled after I paid. Out of stock.
Half the menu was unavailable. I had to change my order three times.
Limited choices near my area at night, only a few outlets are open.
Good variety of restaurants and the menu is up to date.
Item sold out after I placed the order and they cancelled the whole thing.
Restaurant closed but the app still let me order. Wasted time.
So many options late at night, love that the menu shows what is actually available.
App crashed at checkout twice and I lost my cart.
Checkout is smooth and the app is very easy to use.
Payment page froze and I was not sure if my order went through. Confusing.
UI is clean but search is slow and filters reset every time.
Could not apply my address, the app kept spinning. Terrible experience.
Reordering is easy, saved addresses work well.
Got logged out in the middle of ordering and had to start again.
Asked for a refund for the missing item and support has not replied in three days.
Support resolved my refund within minutes. Very helpful and polite.
Chat support gave copy-paste replies and ignored my issue.
Refund came through the next day, appreciate the quick process.
Waiting for my refund for two weeks. Nobody responds.
Not sure what to say, just trying this service for the first time.
They refused a refund even though the food arrived spoiled.
The soup leaked through the bag and soaked everything. Packaging was terrible.
Neat packaging, nothing spilled, and the food stayed intact.
Burger was crushed flat. Looks like the bag was thrown around.
The rider was rude on the phone and honked repeatedly outside my house.
The drink had spilled inside the bag and the container was cracked.
Good sturdy boxes, hot and cold items were packed separately.
Tamper seal was missing and the bag was open. Not comfortable eating it.
